# A TreeStore throws when an expanded parent is added while it is constructed

## Context

Found building #21165 (`examples/grid/treeBigData`, PR #21228). That example's store generates its organization from a reactive config, so its first `add()` runs inside `afterSetAmountRows()` while the store processes its configs. `examples/grid/bigData` uses the same pattern. Any generated parent with `collapsed: false` throws, and the grid never renders. PR #21228 works around it: it generates every node collapsed and expands its first path from `onConstructed()`.

## The Problem

Reproducer `test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStoreConstructionAdd.spec.mjs` (on its branch), on dev `594ca4b014`:

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'indexOf')
    at GeneratedStore.indexOf (src/collection/Base.mjs:1200:26)
    at GeneratedStore.splice (src/data/TreeStore.mjs:1234:66)
    at GeneratedStore.add (src/collection/Base.mjs:182:21)
    at GeneratedStore.add (src/data/Store.mjs:343:19)
    at GeneratedStore.afterSetOpen (…)
    at GeneratedStore.processConfigs (src/core/Base.mjs:954:28)
```

A collapsed parent added the same way projects correctly. The same two records loaded through `data` project correctly when expanded and when collapsed (the spec's two controls).

## The Architectural Reality

- `TreeStore.splice()` decides whether an added child of an existing parent joins the projection with `parentNode.collapsed === false && me.indexOf(parentNode) > -1` (`src/data/TreeStore.mjs:1234`). `Collection.indexOf()` scans `_items`, which is still `null` while the store processes its configs.
- The removal path of the same method already asks the projection's key map instead: `me.map.has(key)`, commented "The projection's key map answers visibility in O(1); `indexOf()` scans it per node".
- A parent added earlier in the same batch is a new root and not yet projected; step 2b projects it together with its visible descendants (`collectVisibleDescendants()`). "Not visible yet" is the right answer for it during construction too.

Design authority: n/a, a thrown `TypeError` on a supported config pattern (fenced error and spec path above).

## The Fix

`src/data/TreeStore.mjs` `splice()`: replace `me.indexOf(parentNode) > -1` with `me.map?.has(parentId)`. It asks the removal path's visibility question, costs O(1) instead of a scan per added child, and is false while no projection exists.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An expanded and a collapsed parent added while the store is constructed project `['unit-1', 'person-1']` and `['unit-1']`, equal to the same records loaded through `data` (the reproducer's four cases).
- [ ] The expanded construction case is red on dev and green at head.
- [ ] `test/playwright/unit/data/TreeStore*.spec.mjs` stay green.

## Out of Scope

- A record whose id is `'root'` collides with the store's top-level `#childrenMap` key (defect note b0454c89). It is a separate defect.
- `examples/grid/treeBigData`'s collapsed generation in PR #21228 stays as it is.
